identity: A quick scripted fall chooses a direction once, then holds a fixed pose.
A connected six-part body tumbles, collides with terrain and settles physically.
The connected body carries the player's incoming movement and knockback into its fall.
One bare headstone rises from the floor with solid black RIP; its stone and lettering share the block texture atlas
A translucent copy floats upward while fading away.
Flames char the skin black before six burned pieces drop one at a time.
A tense full-size body pulses white, charges faster, then disappears in a TNT-strength blast
The skinned body bursts into separate physical pieces that land on the ground.
A visual lightning bolt strikes and chars the skin black; a brief chest jolt releases the connected body into a loose ragdoll fall, with limbs lagging and colliding with the floor.
Ice walls grow around the player and leave an ice shell in place of the body.
The captured body changes to the attacker's skin before falling backward.
A falling anvil visibly flattens and widens the body with a brief rebound.
Gold spreads from one hand across the original skin, armor and held equipment. The finished statue holds its frozen pose, then tips and settles as one heavy rigid body with attached golden equipment.
A holy light beam illuminates the body before an upright ascent.
The player rockets over 100 blocks upward, spins during the climb, then fades into the sky.
The body sinks into the floor and fades into the void.
Parts peel away sideways in sequence and vanish instead of landing as debris.
Separate body parts converge into one point and a totem replaces them.
50/50 choice: the original head-first dust dissolve or a sand body that crumbles into individually colliding grains. The persistent pile scatters when walked through or struck.
Crouch and swing the arms, tuck through a backward somersault, extend, then overbalance into a loose landing.
The body sits cross-legged and fades in place, without floating away.
Stretch under tension, snap back through diminishing elastic rebounds, then settle into an interactive connected physics ragdoll
A balloon lifts the player by one arm, then the player, balloon and string fade away together
A particle wind funnel catches the body, trailing limbs follow the spiral, then the body is thrown out and lands as an interactive connected physics ragdoll.
A giant BAN hammer winds back, swings onto the player with a metallic slam, and rebounds as BANNED flashes above an interactive connected physics ragdoll
A fixed water funnel draws the body through an accelerating inward and downward spiral, then continues briefly after the body disappears at its center.
The player falls forward and lies flat; a pink tulip then grows from the chest of the resting body
Two side walls close inward and squeeze the body into a thin vertical sheet.
An ornate Ace of Hearts rises, takes the player behind its face, flips to its patterned back, then sails away
Severe lag freezes the body, snaps it between positions and rubber-bands it back through bright scanline glitches
Dance on a music box while a delicate chiming melody plays and softly winds down
An eyeless, pure yellow PAC-MAN opens and closes his round pixel mouth, eats the pellets and consumes the player in three timed bites
The player tumbles sideways out of an airlock while the familiar not-the-Impostor verdict appears.
Sadako crawls through the front of a deep, closed CRT television, emerges head and hands first, then drags the player back through its screen; hidden skin sections never protrude through the rear
The player takes the head-pin spot at the front of a full ten-pin rack. A rolling ball clips the ankles, and the player topples through the nine remaining pins in a spreading chain reaction.
A row of oversized dominoes tips in sequence to form a moving bridge under the victim; the final tile falls, the row folds flat, and the victim disappears beneath the last tile.

A cable-suspended three-finger claw stays on the internal rails, lifts the seated victim from the plush bed, transports them above an open internal shaft and releases them into the lower prize compartment.
A short maze corridor appears; Blinky and Inky close from opposite ends, Pac-Man's remaining dot counter hits zero, and the victim becomes a brief yellow maze-shaped sparkle.

corrections: Reviewed complete source mechanism, anticipation, contact and recovery; no generic impact-ring overlay.

identity: A skin-printed sheet creases and reopens down the center, folds both corners and angled edges inward, closes lengthwise, forms two wings, winds backward and launches far forward.

An open office copier receives the player flat on its scanner glass. A bright bar completes a scan before sequential skin-printed pages feed through the recessed front slot and flutter onto the floor.

A closed front-loader opens its hinged glass door for suction. The player enters through the front, tumbles inside the enclosed spinning barrel, then exits through the reopened front door with an upward boost, ragdoll landing and clean sparkles.

A full page carrying the captured player print feeds head-first through an office shredder; the same artwork emerges underneath in flexible paper ribbons that detach, flutter and settle on the ground.
The player briefly inflates, then loses pressure torso-first. Wrinkled skin, outer layers and worn armor sag together as the knees buckle, leaving a recognizable, motionless 3D inflatable shell.

Five increasingly fast shuffle stages hide the player completely. Left-click a cup: only the tracked winning cup reveals the player and wins; a wrong cup opens empty before the true prize is revealed.
Each death chooses one matryoshka scene: six larger painted shells close around a full-size player, or twelve dolls open to reveal exact half-size copies of the player.
The rug's striped edge curls into a rotating roll, takes the player sideways through a full turn and carries the hidden body off the far end.

A floating calendar counts from day one to 999,999,999 as the player slowly grays, grows a long white beard and hunches. The elderly player then transforms into a vanilla skeleton that collapses and dissolves into ash.
A red Impostor strikes with a quick cartoon blood spray; the lower crewmate body and exposed bone drop together, tip onto the floor and remain as the classic Among Us corpse.
